subject: spt-dy
title: SPT.DY.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 198 (EVOL-36). SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) is the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: AF-POST (affinity postulation) and TR (transformation). From SOC-RT: APL-DT (application dictates). From APL-DT: POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: PER-DY (perception dynamics). From AF-POST: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and ATTN (attraction). From ATTN: AFI (affinity insight). From TR: BIA (bi-aitional). From BIA: MT-INFO (multi-information).
